apps.name: AuraLyrics
apps.subtitle: Floating Spotify lyrics for macOS
apps.description: Floating, always-on-top synced lyrics for Spotify, with menu bar controls.
apps.longDescription: AuraLyrics shows synced lyrics in a floating window on macOS. It reads playback from the Spotify desktop app through Spotify's own scripting interface, so there are no API keys and no account, and looks lyrics up in the LRCLIB community database. Aura mode puts three borderless lines over your work, with the colour of the album art on the words rather than behind them. The lyrics view spreads the same colour into a background behind the whole song. Native Swift and SwiftUI, no third-party libraries, no telemetry.
apps.requirements: macOS 14.0 or later; Spotify desktop app
features: Aura mode: three borderless lines with an album-coloured halo
Lyrics view: full song over an album-coloured background
Two-layer cache for instant repeat playback
No accounts, no API keys, no telemetry
